sources.title: GitHub - TontonTremblay/blender2rand
sources.snippet: Overview This pipeline takes .blend files containing animated Jaco robot picking motions (generated in a physics simulator) and renders them with aggressive visual domain randomization for sim-to-real transfer. The motion is never modified — only the visual appearance changes.

sources.title: Figure AI: Grounding the Figure 02 Humanoid in Hardware, Pilots, and ...
sources.snippet: Figure AI's Figure 02 humanoid robot combines custom actuators, 43 degrees of freedom, and foundation model control via OpenAI, Microsoft, and Nvidia. Shipping hardware remains limited to early industrial pilots, with no commercial availability in India and landed costs exceeding INR 75 lakhs.
